name: CYBERSE
notes:
Cyberse GmbH & Co. KG is a German company initially founded in 2013, specializing in web hosting and now operating two distinct brands: ST-Hosting and Cyberse-Hosting. ST-Hosting focuses on flexible, budget-friendly hosting solutions for private users, offering a variety of customizable server packages. Cyberse-Hosting, on the other hand, caters to business clients with tailored IT services and data center solutions, including dedicated servers, virtual office solutions, and high-availability clusters.

Cyberse GmbH & Co. KG prides itself on using high-performance hardware and has developed a proprietary network with robust DDoS protection, operating servers from certified data centers in Frankfurt and Nuremberg. These centers provide low latency and high availability, meeting the rigorous demands of both consumer and business clients. Their infrastructure and secure environment make Cyberse particularly attractive to business clients needing reliable, high-uptime solutions​.
